# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P24](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; Married  <sub>[v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P56](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0056)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick (formerly lived in Scottsford)  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c2 P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** J. A. Harrison  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>; James A.  <sub>[v2 c25 P3](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, bald man with prominent blue eyes and a round face. He has a little fringe of hair around his ears and wears a soft brown beard. After his wife returned, he shaved his beard, trimmed his remaining hair, and wore patched, neat working clothes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000)_

## Personality

Considered an eccentric 'crank' by his Avonlea neighbors, Mr. Harrison is very outspoken, hottempered, and prides himself on telling the blunt truth. Despite his crusty, crabbed, and quick-to-anger exterior, he has a kind heart, a warm sense of humor, and a genuine capacity for friendship. He is stubborn and cantankerous when provoked, but appreciates good company and admits his own flaws. Though previously known for sloppy bachelor housekeeping, he adapts to orderliness after reuniting with his wife.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 c3 P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P43](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0043), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009)_

## History

Mr. J. A. Harrison bought the former Robert Bell farm in Avonlea, right next to Green Gables, and lived as a bachelor with his ill-mannered, profane parrot, Ginger. He earned an early reputation as a crusty, eccentric crank who kept a disorderly house and ate at irregular hours. He first met Anne Shirley in an angry outburst after her Jersey cow broke into his oatfield, but he quickly softened and accepted a peace offering of cake when Anne accidentally sold his own cow. The two became firm friends, frequently sharing tea and conversation. When a newspaper joke falsely implied he was seeking a bride, his estranged wife Emily arrived from New Brunswick to investigate. She cleaned up his house, shaved his beard, and settled in with him after discovering that his parrot Ginger had died. Reunited with Emily, Mr. Harrison became a tidy, shaved, and respectable member of the community, taking an interest in the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and maintaining a warm neighborly bond with Anne and the Cuthbert household.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 c2 P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c3 P40](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0040), [v2 c3 P44](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0044), [v2 c9 P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 c24 P2](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0002), [v2 c24 P44](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0044), [v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 c25 P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055), [v2 c25 P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Scottsford, New Brunswick, where he married Emily Scott  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)</sub>
- Separated from his wife over a quarrel involving his swearing parrot, Ginger, and moved to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)</sub>
- Purchased Robert Bell's farm adjoining Green Gables in Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> I'm a crusty, lonesome, crabbed old chap, but there's something about that little girl makes me feel young again... and it's such a pleasant sensation I'd like to have it repeated once in a while.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

> There's lots of room for improvement in this settlement... and in the people too.  <sub>[v2 c3 P40](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0040)</sub>

> It's the truth and I believe in telling the truth to everybody.  <sub>[v2 c9 P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005)</sub>

> I'm too hasty myself sometimes, miss... far too hasty. But I can't help speaking out just what I think and folks must take me as they find me.  <sub>[v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025)</sub>
